title: MethaneSET-L89: Global Landsat 8/9 Dataset for Methane Emission Detection
description: MethaneSET is a multi-sensor family of AI-ready Earth observation datasets for satellite-based methane plume detection, pairing Sentinel-2 and Landsat-8/9 imagery chips with expert-verified plume labels, flux estimates, and auxiliary wind data (ERA5-Land, GEOS-FP) in cloud-optimized TACO format.

## README.md
# MethaneSET > 🚧 **Under Construction** 🚧 Multi-sensor family of AI-ready datasets for satellite-based methane plume detection. ## Available Versions | Version | Sensor | Status | |---------|--------|--------| | **MethaneSET-S2** | Sentinel-2 MSI | ✅ Available | | **MethaneSET-L89** | Landsat-8/9 OLI | ✅ Available | | **MethaneSET-L5** | Landsat-5 TM | 🔄 Coming soon | | **MethaneSET-EMIT** | EMIT hyperspectral | 🔄 Coming soon | | **MethaneSET-PRISMA** | PRISMA hyperspectral | 🔄 Coming soon | ## Dataset Features ✅ Expert-verified methane plumes ✅ Auxiliary wind data (ERA5-Land, GEOS-FP) ✅ Rich metadata (flux, source type, geometry) ✅ TACO format (cloud-optimized, SQL-queryable) ## Quick Start ```python import tacoreader # Load from Source Cooperative dataset = tacoreader.load("https://data.source.coop/csaybar/methaneset/s2") print(f"Samples: {len(dataset.data)}") ``` ## License [CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/) ## Acknowledgements **Maintained by**: University of Valencia, University of Salzburg, and Universitat Politècnica de València **Funded by**: [Global Methane Hub](https://www.globalmethanehub.org/) --- 📖 **Full documentation**: [methaneset.github.io](https://methaneset.github.io) 💾 **Data repository**: [Source Cooperative](https://data.source.coop/csaybar/methaneset/)
